petro-01.title: From Raw Logs to Net Pay You Can Defend: Petrophysics Studio on Ekene-1 | Petrolord Suite
petro-01.summary:
The first of three Petrophysics Studio demos. One well, Ekene-1: shale volume, porosity, water resistivity from the well itself, and the saturation model that changes the answer, through to zones, net pay and a published result.

The Ekene field is synthetic, built from a single earth model, so every answer can be checked against the truth.

petro-02.title: Is Our Rw Right? Two Independent Checks in Petrophysics Studio | Petrolord Suite
petro-02.summary:
The second of three Petrophysics Studio demos. Two independent checks on the water resistivity, then low, mid and high cases for Ekene-1.

The Ekene field is synthetic, built from a single earth model, so every answer can be checked against the truth.

petro-03.title: How Sure Are We? P90, P50 and P10 Net Pay in Petrophysics Studio | Petrolord Suite
petro-03.summary:
The third of three Petrophysics Studio demos. A probabilistic run on Ekene-1, what drives the range, and the hand-over to ReservoirCalc Pro.

The Ekene field is synthetic, built from a single earth model, so every answer can be checked against the truth.
